or for any person to perform a coordinating function.","citation":"P.L. 2026, c.043 (A3497 1R ACS), Section 4; C.56:9-20 to 56:9-26","quoted_span":"It shall be unlawful and a violation of the \"New Jersey Antitrust Act,\" P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.) for: a. a rental property owner, or any agent, representative, or subcontractor thereof, to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or otherwise exchange any form of consideration in return for the use of, the services of a coordinator","logic_json":"{\"coverage\":{\"all\":[{\"fact\":\"state\",\"op\":\"eq\",\"value\":\"NJ\"},{\"fact\":\"uses_coordinator_algorithmic_device\",\"op\":\"eq\",\"value\":true},{\"fact\":\"coordinator_performs_coordinating_function\",\"op\":\"eq\",\"value\":true}]},\"exemptions\":{\"any\":[{\"fact\":\"research_statistical_analysis_only\",\"op\":\"eq\",\"value\":true},{\"fact\":\"public_rent_estimate_no_cost\",\"op\":\"eq\",\"value\":true},{\"fact\":\"real_estate_brokerage_database_equal_terms\",\"op\":\"eq\",\"value\":true},{\"fact\":\"government_entity_affordability_controls\",\"op\":\"eq\",\"value\":true}]}}","evidence_json":"[{\"field\":\"status\",\"quoted_span\":\"P.L. 2026, CHAPTER 43, approved July 20, 2026\"},{\"field\":\"requirement\",\"quoted_span\":\"It shall be unlawful and a violation of the \"New Jersey Antitrust Act,\" P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.) for: a. a rental property owner, or any agent, representative, or subcontractor thereof, to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or otherwise exchange any form of consideration in return for the use of, the services of a coordinator; c. two or more persons to engage in or otherwise facilitate parallel pricing coordination\"},{\"field\":\"exemptions\",\"quoted_span\":\"Coordinating function shall not include the following: (1) providing, using, or collecting competitively sensitive information solely for the purpose of conducting research, statistical analysis, or testing, where the competitively sensitive information is not used in setting or recommending rental prices, material lease terms, fees, occupancy rates or levels, or other contract terms for current or future leases; (2) developing an estimated amount of rent that is made available to the public at no cost; (3) the use of a real estate brokerage database that is available on equal terms to subscribers that lists properties for rent or sale but does not: (a) set or recommend rental prices, material lease terms, or occupancy rates or levels;
